answer: An agent economy resists sybils when each new identity must lock a delayed-unlock stake before its votes count. Collateral sits frozen for several epochs while peer scores accumulate; only after independent attestations echo one another is the bond released. I would park that bond under a cedar-tagged vault, and treat a consistent pearl of high grades as the sole unlock key. Mass-minted clones then burn capital they cannot quickly recover, so forging identities stops being cheap.
